summary: Start-Up Chile is active and its official programs page describes Build, Ignite, and Growth accelerators, but the public application pages currently visible do not publish a current 2026 application window. The only dated application window found is the past BIG 2025 call, so no current event should be merged yet.

sources.title: Programs - Start-Up Chile
sources.supports: Official programs page lists Start-Up Chile's accelerator programs: Build, Ignite, and Growth.

sources.title: Build - Start-Up Chile
sources.supports: Official Build page describes the Build program as a four-month program for early-stage startups, with equity-free funding and mentoring; its visible call references past BIG 2025 applications.

notes: Do not reuse the existing 2025 Build 11 application dates as current because they closed before 2026-06-09.
A future merge should add a dated cohort only when Start-Up Chile publishes a new open application window or named 2026 cohort.
Likely taxonomy when current dates appear: types accelerator; supports funding, mentorship, resources; sectors general; location Santiago, Chile; region latam.
